callingMaterial.background.acolyte.blurb: You served in a temple, learning its rites and its politics, and the faithful still owe you shelter.
callingMaterial.background.acolyte.featu: As a servant of your faith, you and your companions can expect free healing and care at any temple, shrine or other establishment of your religion, though you must provide the material components for spells. Its priests will support you in ways that do not risk their lives, and you may have ties to one temple in particular.
callingMaterial.background.charlatan.blu: You lived by your wits and a hundred false faces, and you always have another identity ready.
callingMaterial.background.charlatan.fea: You have a second identity with documents, established acquaintances and disguises to match. You can also forge documents, including official papers and personal letters, as long as you have seen an example of the kind you are trying to copy.
callingMaterial.background.criminal.blur: You made your living breaking the law, and you still know who to call in the underworld.
callingMaterial.background.criminal.feat: You have a reliable and trustworthy contact in the criminal underworld. You know how to get messages to and from them, even over great distances, through the local messengers, corrupt caravan masters and seedy sailors who carry them.
callingMaterial.background.entertainer.b: You performed for crowds and courts, and any tavern will trade a bed for a show.
callingMaterial.background.entertainer.f: You can always find a place to perform, usually an inn or tavern but sometimes a circus, a theater or a noble's court. In return you receive free lodging and food of a modest standard for as long as you perform each night, and your performance makes you a local figure whom strangers tend to like.
callingMaterial.background.folk_hero.blu: You stood up for the common folk when it mattered, and they remember.
callingMaterial.background.folk_hero.fea: Since you come from the ranks of the common folk, you fit in among them with ease. You can find a place to hide, rest or recuperate among other commoners unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them. They will shield you from the law or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.
callingMaterial.background.guild_artisan: You are a member in good standing of a craft guild, with its workshops and its lawyers behind you.

Your guild will provide you with lodging and food if necessary and pay for your funeral if needed. In some cities a guildhall offers a central place to meet other members. Guilds wield political power: if you are accused of a crime, your guild will support you if a good case can be made, and it can help you gain access to powerful people. Membership costs 5 gp a month in dues.
callingMaterial.background.hermit.blurb: You lived apart from the world in seclusion, and came back with a discovery.
callingMaterial.background.hermit.featur: The quiet seclusion of your hermitage gave you access to a unique and powerful discovery: a great truth, a hidden site, a lost fact, or a secret whose reveal could shake the powerful. Work with the DM to determine what it is and what it means for the campaign.
callingMaterial.background.noble.blurb: You were born to rank and privilege, and doors open for you that stay shut to others.
callingMaterial.background.noble.feature: Thanks to your noble birth, people are inclined to think the best of you. You are welcome in high society, and people assume you have the right to be wherever you are. The common folk make every effort to accommodate you, other people of high birth treat you as a member of the same social sphere, and you can secure an audience with a local noble if you need to.
callingMaterial.background.outlander.blu: You grew up in the wilds far from civilization, and the land still feeds you.
callingMaterial.background.outlander.fea: You have an excellent memory for maps and geography, and you can always recall the general layout of terrain, settlements and other features around you. In addition, you can find food and fresh water for yourself and up to five other people each day, provided the land offers berries, small game, water and so forth.
callingMaterial.background.sage.blurb: You spent years among books and scholars, and you know where every answer is kept.
callingMaterial.background.sage.featureD: When you attempt to learn or recall a piece of lore, if you do not know it, you often know where and from whom you can obtain it: a library, scriptorium, university, a sage or another learned person or creature. The DM might rule that the knowledge is secret or found only in a hard to reach place.
callingMaterial.background.sailor.blurb: You worked the decks of a ship, and captains will take you and your friends aboard for a hand's work.
callingMaterial.background.sailor.featur: When you need to, you can secure free passage on a sailing ship for yourself and your companions. You might sail on the ship you served on or another you have good relations with. Because you are calling in a favor, the ship's schedule and route cannot be guaranteed, and you and your companions are expected to help the crew during the voyage.
callingMaterial.background.soldier.blurb: You served in an army, and those who served with you still recognize your rank.
callingMaterial.background.soldier.featu: You have a military rank from your career as a soldier. Soldiers loyal to your former organization still recognize your authority and influence, and they defer to you if they are of a lower rank. You can invoke your rank to exert influence over other soldiers and requisition simple equipment or horses for temporary use, and you can usually gain access to friendly military encampments and fortresses where your rank is recognized.
callingMaterial.background.urchin.blurb: You grew up alone on the streets, and you know the city's hidden ways better than anyone.
callingMaterial.background.urchin.featur: You know the secret patterns and flow to cities and can find passages through the urban sprawl that others would miss. When you are not in combat, you and companions you lead can travel between any two locations in a city twice as fast as your speed would normally allow.
callingMaterial.background.corpo_dropout: You walked out of a megacorp tower with insider skills, a few secrets, and a target on your back.

You still hold a valid corporate ID from your old employer. It gets you past lobby security and into the lower floors of any megacorp tower, and a former colleague will still take your call, though not risk their job for you.
callingMaterial.background.street_doc.bl: You patch up runners in an unlicensed clinic. No questions, credits up front, favors remembered.
callingMaterial.background.street_doc.fe: You know where to find unlicensed care in any district, and its staff will treat you and your crew first, discreetly, and on credit. In return you are expected to bring business and keep quiet about what you see.
callingMaterial.background.fixers_runner: You moved packages and secrets for a fixer; half the undercity owes you or is owed by you.
Half the undercity owes you a small favor or is owed one. Once per session you can call one in: a safe room for the night, a name, a ride, or a package moved without questions.
You grew up in the maintenance ducts of an arcology and know every vent, camera blind spot, and cargo lift.

You can find a maintenance route into or through any arcology or corporate block that others would miss. When you lead the party through the ducts, you travel between two points in the structure twice as fast.
callingMaterial.background.chrome_pit_fi: You fought augmented brawlers in the cage circuit, and the crowds still chant your handle.
Fight crowds remember your handle. In any gym, cage or betting den you can find a place to sleep, a meal and a sparring partner, and a promoter will always have work for a fighter with a name.
You carried encrypted payloads through hostile grid sectors, sometimes in your own headware.
You know the couriers' dead drops and handshakes. You can leave or collect a message or a small package in any city without meeting the other party, and no one can trace it to you.
callingMaterial.background.guild_enginee: A certified member of the engineers' guild, welcome in any workshop and fluent in blueprints.

Your guild card is honored in any workshop, foundry or engineering hall. You can borrow tools and a bench, read the guild's blueprints, and expect lodging from a fellow member, provided your dues are paid.
callingMaterial.background.airship_deckh: You crewed a trade airship, splicing rigging in gales and trading gossip in every port tower.

Every port tower has someone who crewed with you. You can secure passage on an airship for yourself and your companions in exchange for working the rigging, and you hear the gossip of the docks before it reaches the ground.
callingMaterial.background.clockwork_app: You served a master artificer, winding automata and learning which gears hide the maker's tricks.
Having wound and repaired a master's automata, you can tell at a glance how a clockwork device is meant to work, where its maker hid the override, and whether it has been tampered with.
You shoveled coal in the great engine halls, and the laborers' union still counts you as family.
The laborers' union counts you as family. Its halls will feed and hide you, its stokers pass you word of what moves through the engine rooms, and a picket line will open for you.
callingMaterial.background.aether_schola: You studied the aether sciences at a famous academy and can talk your way into any symposium.
Your academy name gets you into any symposium, salon or laboratory. Scholars will hear you out, share their notes, and put you up for a night, expecting a lecture in return.
callingMaterial.background.constabulary_: You walked a beat and closed cases for the city constabulary before turning in your badge.
Your retired warrant card still turns heads. Constables will speak to you as a colleague, show you a case file if asked quietly, and overlook a minor infraction, unless their captain is watching.
callingMaterial.background.vault_born.bl: Raised in a sealed shelter on old-world books and drills, you stepped outside knowing everything but the wasteland.
callingMaterial.background.vault_born.fe: You were taught from the old world's books. You can read pre-war signage, manuals and maps, and you know what a ruin was for and where its stores, generators and exits should be.
callingMaterial.background.wasteland_sca: You strip ruins for parts and provisions, and you can tell worthwhile salvage from scrap at a glance.
You can tell worthwhile salvage from scrap at a glance. When you search a ruin, you find the parts, fuel and provisions others overlook, and you know which merchant will pay for them.
callingMaterial.background.caravan_guard: You escorted traders between settlements, and every waystation on the route knows your face.
Every waystation and caravanserai on the routes you guarded knows your face. You and your companions can expect a meal, a bunk and the latest news of the road wherever a caravan stops.
You fled a doomsday congregation and can still recite its liturgy well enough to pass as faithful.
You can recite the congregation's liturgy and signs well enough to pass as one of the faithful. Cultists take you for a believer until you give them reason not to.
callingMaterial.background.rad_zone_guid: You lead travelers through glowing craters and storm fronts, reading hazards the way sailors read weather.
You read the wasteland the way sailors read weather. When you lead the party, you sense storms, radiation and hostile ground before they reach you, and you can always find a route around them.
callingMaterial.background.settlement_me: You kept a settlement alive with scavenged medicine and steady hands when the raiders came.
You can tell at a glance who is dying, who is faking and what killed the ones who did not make it. Settlements will shelter a medic, and their people will bring you what supplies they have.
You tend the churchyard and its dead, and you know which graves are best left undisturbed.
You know every graveyard's layout and which graves are best left alone. The dead do not rise on ground you have tended, and church wardens will shelter you among the tombs.
callingMaterial.background.asylum_surviv: They locked you away for what you claimed to see. You were right, and you learned to read people to get out.
Having been locked away for telling the truth, you can tell when someone is lying about what they have seen, and other survivors of the veil will speak with you when they will speak with no one else.
callingMaterial.background.occult_librar: You catalogued books that should not exist and remember exactly where the worst ones are shelved.
You remember where the worst books are shelved. In any library or archive you can find the restricted collection, and you know which volume holds the answer, though not always the cost of reading it.
callingMaterial.background.seance_medium: You hold sittings for the grieving. Most nights it is theater; some nights something answers.
You can hold a sitting for the grieving. Usually it is theater, and it pays. Sometimes something answers, and when it does, you are the one it speaks through.
callingMaterial.background.cursed_bloodl: Your family name opens doors and ends conversations; everyone has heard what happens to your kin.

Your family name is known. It opens doors among those who fear it and closes them among those who know what it means, and once per session it turns aside a threat that would rather not cross your kin.
callingMaterial.background.night_watchma: You walked the town's streets after dark with a lantern and a ring of keys, and you noticed things.
You still carry a ring of keys and know which doors they open. After dark you can move through the town unchallenged, and you notice what has changed since your last round.
callingMaterial.background.private_inqui: You take discreet cases for paying clients, and your ledger holds half the town's secrets.
Your ledger holds half the town's secrets. Once per session you can consult it for a fact about a local person of standing: a debt, an affair, a grudge, or who they were seen with.
callingMaterial.background.beat_reporter: You chase stories for the local paper, and a press card opens doors that stay shut to strangers.
A press card opens doors that stay shut to strangers. Officials, witnesses and the wealthy will grant you an interview, and printers will run what you bring them.
callingMaterial.background.reformed_burg: You went straight years ago, but you still see every house as a puzzle of latches and sight lines.
You see every building as a puzzle of latches and sight lines. Given a minute to look, you can say how a place is secured, where its blind spots are, and how you would have gotten in.
callingMaterial.background.courtroom_cle: You filed the town's suits and wills for years, and you know where every record is buried.
You know where every record is buried. In any courthouse, registry or archive you can find the deed, the will or the filing that matters, and the clerks let you look.
callingMaterial.background.disgraced_soc: Scandal cost you your standing, but you still know the guest lists, the grudges, and the back stairs.
Scandal cost you your standing, not your memory. You know the guest lists, the grudges and the back stairs of every great house, and a servant or a faded friend will still let you in.
callingMaterial.background.police_inform: You traded whispers to the law to stay free, and both the precinct and the street think you are theirs.
The precinct and the street both think you are theirs. You can get a message to either side, and each will tell you what the other is planning, as long as neither learns you asked.
callingMaterial.background.plague_doctor: You walked sealed districts in beak and wax, and guards still let your mask through the barricades.
Guards still let your mask through the barricades. You can enter and leave sealed districts, and the sick and their families will tell a plague doctor what they tell no one else.
callingMaterial.background.witch_hunters: Raised by an order that burns the unclean, you can read their trail signs and their warrants.
You can read the order's trail signs and warrants. You know where the hunters have been, whom they are after, and how to pass yourself off as one of their wards when it counts.
callingMaterial.background.penitent_pilg: You walk the old pilgrim roads atoning for something, and keepers of wayside shrines shelter you.
Keepers of wayside shrines shelter penitents. On any pilgrim road you can find a shrine that offers you and your companions food, a roof, and word of who passed before you.
callingMaterial.background.sellsword_des: You abandoned a mercenary company that does not forgive. You know their ways, and they know your name.
You know your old company's signs, camps and habits. You can spot its members, predict how it fights, and find its quartermasters, but they know your name and want the desertion settled.
You copied epitaphs and funerary rites in the great necropolis, and its wardens still admit you.
The wardens of the great necropolis still admit you. You can enter the tombs, read the funerary rites carved there, and learn what the dead were buried with and why.
callingMaterial.background.beggar_prophe: You preach doom on street corners, and the desperate who listen bring you rumors and bread.
The desperate who hear you preach bring you rumors and bread. In any city you can gather a small congregation within a day, and they will pass you what the streets are saying.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.barbaria: Spirit Seeker
Ritual casting of beast sense and speak with animals.
Totem Spirit

Choose a totem: Bear gives resistance to all damage but psychic while raging, Eagle gives a Dash bonus action and no opportunity-attack advantage against you, Wolf gives allies advantage on melee attacks against enemies within 5 feet of you.
Aspect of the Beast

A permanent boon from the totem: Bear doubles carrying capacity and gives advantage on Strength checks to push, pull, lift or break, Eagle grants sight to 1 mile and no disadvantage on Perception in dim light, Wolf lets you track at a fast pace and move stealthily at a normal pace.
Spirit Walker
Cast commune with nature as a ritual; the answer arrives as a spirit beast.
Totemic Attunement

While raging: Bear makes enemies within 5 feet suffer disadvantage attacking anyone but you, Eagle grants flight equal to your walking speed for a turn at a time, Wolf lets a bonus action knock a Large or smaller creature prone when you hit it.
Ancestral Protectors
While raging, the first creature you hit each turn has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you, and its damage against others is halved until your next turn.
Spirit Shield
While raging, a reaction reduces damage to an ally you can see within 30 feet by 2d6, rising to 3d6 at 10th level and 4d6 at 14th.
Consult the Spirits
Cast augury or clairvoyance once per short or long rest, using Wisdom, without a slot or components.
Vengeful Ancestors
Damage prevented by Spirit Shield is dealt straight back to the attacker as force damage.
Storm Aura

A 10-foot aura while raging, activated as a bonus action: Desert deals 2 fire damage to every other creature in it, Sea forces one creature you pick to make a Dexterity save or take 1d6 lightning, Tundra grants every ally in it 2 temporary hit points. Damage and hit points scale with barbarian level.
Storm Soul

Resistance to your aura's damage type and a matching boon: Desert gives fire resistance and heat protection, Sea gives lightning resistance, swim speed and water breathing, Tundra gives cold resistance and lets you freeze 5 feet of water.
Shielding Storm
Every ally inside your Storm Aura shares your Storm Soul damage resistance.
Raging Storm

Your aura gains a rider once per turn: Desert deals fire damage to a creature that hits you, Sea knocks a creature prone on a failed Strength save, Tundra halves a creature's speed on a failed Strength save.
Divine Fury
The first creature you hit each turn while raging takes an extra 1d6 + half your barbarian level radiant or necrotic damage.
Warrior of the Gods
A spell that restores you to life needs no material component.
Fanatical Focus
Once per rage, reroll a failed saving throw and use the new result.
Zealous Presence
A bonus action, once per long rest, grants up to ten allies within 60 feet advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn.
Rage Beyond Death
While raging, dropping to 0 hit points does not knock you out; you fight on and only die if the rage ends while you are still at 0.
Form of the Beast

When you rage, grow a natural weapon until the rage ends: Bite deals 1d8 piercing and heals you when you are below half hit points, Claws deal 1d6 slashing and grant an extra attack with them, Tail deals 1d8 piercing with 10-foot reach and adds to AC as a reaction.
Bestial Soul
Your natural weapons count as magical, and you can adapt to swim, climb or jump after each rest.
Infectious Fury
Twice per long rest, a natural-weapon hit forces a Wisdom save: the target either attacks a creature of your choice or takes 2d12 psychic damage.
Call the Hunt
A number of times per long rest equal to your Constitution modifier, grant up to five allies an extra weapon damage die on one hit per turn while you gain temporary hit points.
Magic Awareness
As an action, sense spells and magic items within 60 feet, a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.
Wild Surge
Roll on your wild magic table each time you rage; the rolled effect lasts as long as the rage.
Bolstering Magic
A proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest, touch an ally to grant a bonus d3 on attacks and ability checks for 10 minutes, or restore one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower.
Unstable Backlash
When you take damage or fail a save while raging, a reaction rerolls your Wild Surge effect.
Controlled Surge
Roll twice on the wild magic table and choose which result takes hold.
Giant's Power
Learn Giant and the druidcraft cantrip.
Elemental Cleaver
While raging, one weapon deals your chosen elemental damage instead of its own type and gains the thrown property with a 20/60 range, returning to your hand each throw.
Mighty Impel
As a bonus action while raging, move a Large or smaller creature within 10 feet up to 30 feet through the air; an unwilling one gets a Strength save.
Demiurgic Colossus
While raging you grow to Large, your reach grows by 5 feet, Elemental Cleaver's throw range doubles and its damage grows by 1d10.
Elemental Fury
Once per turn while raging, add your rage damage to an Elemental Cleaver hit again, or force a Constitution save on a creature within 10 feet for 3d8 of your element.
Combat Superiority

Four superiority dice of d8, refilling on a short or long rest, spent on maneuvers with a save DC of 8 + proficiency + Strength or Dexterity. The dice grow to five at 7th level and six at 15th, and to d10 at 10th level and d12 at 18th.
Maneuvers
Three maneuvers known, such as Trip Attack, Disarming Attack, Riposte, Precision Attack, Menacing Attack and Commander's Strike, rising to five known at 7th level, seven at 10th and nine at 15th.
Student of War
Proficiency with one kind of artisan's tools.
Know Your Enemy
A minute of observation reveals whether a creature beats you in two chosen traits such as Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, AC, current hit points, class levels or fighter levels.
Relentless
When you roll initiative with no superiority dice left, you regain one.
Spellcasting (Eldritch Knight)
Third-caster wizard spellcasting keyed to Intelligence, drawn mostly from abjuration and evocation.
Weapon Bond
Bond up to two weapons in an hour-long ritual: you cannot be disarmed of them and can summon one to your hand as a bonus action.
War Magic
After casting a cantrip with your action, a bonus action makes one weapon attack.
Eldritch Strike
A weapon hit gives that creature disadvantage on its next save against a spell of yours before the end of your next turn.
Arcane Charge
Action Surge also teleports you up to 30 feet.
Improved War Magic
War Magic works after casting any spell, not only a cantrip.
Arcane Archer Lore
The prestidigitation or druidcraft cantrip, and proficiency in Arcana or Nature.
Arcane Shot

Two Arcane Shot options known, used twice per short or long rest on an arrow hit: Banishing, Beguiling, Bursting, Enfeebling, Grasping, Piercing, Seeking or Shadow. More options are learned at 7th, 10th, 15th and 18th level.
Magic Arrow
Arrows you fire from a shortbow or longbow count as magical.
Curving Shot
A bonus action rerolls a missed magic-arrow attack against a different target within 60 feet.
Ever-Ready Shot
When you roll initiative with no Arcane Shot uses left, you regain one.
Bonus Proficiency (Cavalier)
One skill from a knightly list or proficiency with land vehicles.
Born to the Saddle
Advantage on saves to stay mounted, mounting costs only 5 feet of movement, and you land on your feet from a fall of 10 feet or less.
Unwavering Mark

A creature you hit in melee is marked until your next turn: it has disadvantage attacking anyone else, and on your next turn you can make a bonus attack against it that deals extra damage on a hit and gives it disadvantage on its next attack. Usable a Strength-modifier number of times per long rest.
Warding Maneuver
A reaction adds 1d8 to an ally's AC against one attack and halves the damage on a hit, a Constitution-modifier number of times per long rest.
Hold the Line
A reaction makes an opportunity attack against a creature that moves 5 feet or more while in your reach, stopping it dead.
Ferocious Charger
Once per turn, a hit after moving 10 feet in a straight line knocks a Large or smaller creature prone on a failed Strength save.
Vigilant Defender
You get a reaction opportunity attack on every other creature's turn, not just once per round.
Bonus Proficiency (Samurai)
Proficiency in one social skill or a language.
Fighting Spirit
A bonus action grants advantage on weapon attacks this turn and 5 temporary hit points, rising to 10 at 10th level and 15 at 15th; three uses per long rest.
Elegant Courtier
Wisdom saving throws use your Charisma modifier if it is better, and you gain proficiency in Persuasion or expertise if already proficient.
Tireless Spirit
When you roll initiative with no Fighting Spirit uses left, you regain one.
Rapid Strike
Trade advantage on one attack for an extra attack against the same target.
Strength before Death
Once per long rest, a reaction on taking damage lets you act immediately before the damage is applied.
Manifest Echo
A bonus action summons a magical echo of yourself within 15 feet with 1 hit point and your AC; you may attack from its space, swap places with it, and move it 30 feet as a bonus action.
Unleash Incarnation
Make one extra melee attack from your echo's space when you take the Attack action, a Constitution-modifier number of times per long rest.
Echo Avatar
Project your senses into the echo and send it up to 1,000 feet away for 10 minutes.
Shadow Martyr
A reaction makes your echo take an attack aimed at another creature; once per short or long rest.
Reclaim Potential
When your echo is destroyed by damage, gain temporary hit points of 2d6 + your Constitution modifier, a Constitution-modifier number of times per long rest.
Legion of One
Regain a use of Unleash Incarnation on initiative, and manifest two echoes at once.
Psionic Power (Psi Warrior)
A pool of Psionic Energy dice, twice your proficiency bonus per long rest, starting at d6 and growing with fighter level; one die returns on a short rest.
Protective Field
A reaction spends a die to reduce damage to you or an ally within 30 feet by the die plus your Intelligence modifier.
Psionic Strike
Once per turn, spend a die to add it plus your Intelligence modifier as force damage to a hit.
Telekinetic Movement
Move a Large or smaller object or willing creature 30 feet with your mind, free once per short rest or by spending a die.
Telekinetic Adept
Psi-Powered Leap lets you fly briefly as a bonus action, and Telekinetic Thrust can knock a Psionic Strike target prone or push it 10 feet.
Guarded Mind
Resistance to psychic damage, and a reaction-free end to being charmed or frightened by spending a die.
Bulwark of Force
A bonus action gives yourself and up to your Intelligence modifier in allies half cover for a minute; once per long rest or by spending a die.
Telekinetic Master
Cast telekinesis for free once per long rest, and make one weapon attack as a bonus action while concentrating on it.
Bonus Proficiencies (Rune Knight)
Smith's tools and the Giant language.
Rune Carver

Inscribe runes on your gear, two at 3rd level and more at 7th, 10th and 15th: Cloud, Fire, Frost, Stone, Hill and Storm, each with a passive benefit and an invokable effect once per short or long rest.
Giant's Might
A bonus action for a minute makes you Large, gives advantage on Strength checks and saves, and adds 1d6 to one damage roll per turn; a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Runic Shield
A reaction forces an attacker to reroll a hit against an ally within 60 feet, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Great Stature
You grow 3d4 inches permanently and Giant's Might's bonus damage becomes 1d8.
Master of Runes
Invoke each rune twice per short or long rest.
Runic Juggernaut
Giant's Might deals 1d10 and can make you Huge with 5 extra feet of reach.
Rallying Cry
Second Wind also heals up to three allies within 60 feet for your fighter level.
Royal Envoy
Proficiency and expertise in Persuasion, plus one extra language.
Inspiring Surge
Action Surge also lets an ally within 60 feet use a reaction to make one weapon attack, two allies from 18th level.
Bulwark
Indomitable also lets one ally within 60 feet reroll a failed ability check.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.rogue.as: Proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.
Advantage on attacks against any creature that has not taken a turn yet, and any hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
Spend 25 gp and seven days to build a false identity you can adopt convincingly.
After studying someone for three hours, mimic their speech, writing and behaviour well enough to fool most observers.
When you hit a surprised creature, it makes a Constitution save against 8 + Dexterity + proficiency or takes double damage.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.rogue.ar: Third-caster wizard spellcasting keyed to Intelligence, drawn mostly from enchantment and illusion.
Your mage hand is invisible, and can pick locks, disarm traps, stow items and pick pockets at your Sleight of Hand bonus.
A creature you are hidden from has disadvantage on saves against your spell that turn.
A bonus action uses mage hand to distract a creature, giving you advantage on attacks against it that turn.
A reaction steals a spell cast at you on a failed save by the caster, denying them the spell for 8 hours and letting you cast it once; recharges on a long rest.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.rogue.ma: Proficiency with the disguise kit, forgery kit and one gaming set, two extra languages, and the ability to mimic a heard speech pattern and accent.
Use the Help action as a bonus action at up to 30 feet.
A minute of observation reveals whether a creature is your better or worse in Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma and class levels.
A reaction redirects an attack aimed at you onto a creature within 5 feet that is giving you cover.
Your thoughts cannot be read, magic always reads you as truthful, and you choose what a mind-reader finds.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.rogue.sw: A creature you attack in melee cannot make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.
Add your Charisma modifier to initiative, and sneak attack works whenever you are within 5 feet of your target alone, with no need for advantage.
A Persuasion check against a creature's Insight either charms it into following you peacefully or fixes its attention on you in a fight for a minute.
A bonus action grants advantage on your next Acrobatics or Athletics check.
Once per short or long rest, reroll a missed attack with advantage.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.rogue.in: Treat any Insight roll of 7 or lower as an 8.
A bonus action makes a Perception check for hidden things or an Investigation check for clues.
A bonus-action Insight check against a creature's Deception lets you sneak attack it for a minute without needing advantage or an ally.
Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks after moving no more than half your speed on your turn.
Sense illusions, shapechangers and other deceptions within 30 feet, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
Sneak attack against your Insightful Fighting target deals an extra 3d6.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.rogue.sc: A reaction moves you half your speed when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet, without provoking.
Proficiency and expertise in Nature and Survival.
Your walking speed rises by 10 feet, along with any climb or swim speed you have.
Advantage on initiative, and the first creature you hit on your first turn gives your allies advantage against it until your next turn.
A bonus action makes an extra attack, and you can sneak attack twice per turn as long as it is against different targets.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.rogue.ph: After each rest, gain proficiency in one skill or tool of your choice.
After a sneak attack drops or wounds a creature, a second creature within 30 feet takes half your sneak attack dice in necrotic damage; a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
A soul trinket forms when a creature dies near you: it grants advantage on death and Constitution saves, resistance to poison, and can be spent to power Wails from the Grave or question the dead.
A bonus action makes you spectral for 10 minutes with a 10-foot fly speed and the ability to move through creatures and objects; free once per long rest, otherwise costs a soul trinket.
Wails from the Grave triggers alongside every sneak attack at full strength, and a soul trinket forms at the end of each long rest.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.rogue.so: A pool of Psionic Energy dice, twice your proficiency bonus per long rest, starting at d6 and growing with rogue level; one returns on a short rest.
Spend a die to turn a failed check with a proficient skill or tool into a success if the die closes the gap.
Establish telepathic communication with creatures you can see for hours, free once per long rest and otherwise for a die.
Manifest a thrown or melee psychic blade as part of an attack, dealing 1d6 psychic plus ability modifier, with a bonus-action second blade at 1d4; the dice grow with rogue level.
Homing Strikes adds a die to a missed Psychic Blades attack, and Psychic Teleportation throws a blade to teleport yourself up to 10 times your die roll in feet.
Turn invisible for an hour as an action, free once per long rest and otherwise for a die; it ends if you deal damage or force a save.
A sneak attack with Psychic Blades can stun a creature for a minute on a failed Wisdom save; free once per long rest and otherwise for three dice.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.sorcerer: Wild Magic Surge
After casting a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM may have you roll a d20; on a 1 you roll on the wild magic table.
Tides of Chaos
Gain advantage on one attack, check or save; the DM can then trigger a Wild Magic Surge to restore the use.
Bend Luck
A reaction spends 2 sorcery points to add or subtract 1d4 on another creature's attack, check or save.
Controlled Chaos
Roll twice on the wild magic table and pick either result.
Spell Bombardment
Once per turn, the highest damage die you roll for a spell explodes: roll it again and add it.
Divine Magic
Add the cleric spell list to your sorcerer spell choices, plus one affinity spell matching your divine bent.
Favored by the Gods
Once per short or long rest, add 2d4 to a failed save or missed attack.
Empowered Healing
Spend 1 sorcery point to reroll healing dice for yourself or an ally, once per turn.
Otherworldly Wings
A bonus action grants a 30-foot flying speed with spectral wings.
Unearthly Recovery
Once per long rest, a bonus action at half hit points or less restores hit points equal to half your maximum.
Eyes of the Dark
Darkvision to 120 feet, and darkness can be cast for 2 sorcery points and seen through.
Strength of the Grave
A Charisma save against 5 + the damage leaves you at 1 hit point instead of 0; once per long rest.
Hound of Ill Omen
Spend 3 sorcery points to summon a shadow dire wolf that chases one creature, gives your spells advantage against it, and blocks its escape.
Shadow Walk
A bonus action teleports 120 feet between dim or dark spaces.
Umbral Form
Spend 6 sorcery points to become shadow for a minute: resistance to all but force and radiant damage, and the ability to move through creatures and objects.
Wind Speaker
You speak, read and write Primordial and its dialects.
Tempestuous Magic
Before or after casting a spell of 1st level or higher, a bonus action lets you fly 10 feet without provoking.
Heart of the Storm
Resistance to lightning and thunder damage, and casting a spell of those types deals half your sorcerer level in damage to creatures within 10 feet.
Storm Guide
Stop rain around you or steer the wind's direction as a bonus action.
Storm's Fury
A reaction deals your sorcerer level in lightning damage to a melee attacker and pushes it 20 feet on a failed Strength save.
Wind Soul
Immunity to lightning and thunder damage, a 60-foot flying speed, and the ability to grant allies 30 feet of flight for an hour once per long rest.
Psionic Spells
A set of psionic spells always known that do not count against your spells known, swappable for divination and enchantment spells as you level.
Telepathic Speech
A bonus action opens a telepathic link with one creature within 30 feet for minutes equal to your sorcerer level.
Psionic Sorcery
Cast your psionic spells by spending sorcery points instead of a slot, with no verbal, somatic or costly components.
Psychic Defenses
Resistance to psychic damage and advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.
Revelation in Flesh
Spend 1 or more sorcery points for a minute of aberrant change: see invisible things, swim and breathe water, fly, or squeeze through tiny gaps.
Warping Implosion
Once per long rest, teleport 120 feet and pull creatures toward your old space for 3d10 force damage.
Clockwork Magic
A set of order-themed spells always known that do not count against your spells known, swappable for abjuration and transmutation spells as you level.
Restore Balance
A reaction cancels advantage or disadvantage on a roll within 60 feet, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Bastion of Law
Spend 1 to 5 sorcery points to give a creature that many d8s to spend reducing damage, until your next long rest.
Trance of Order
For a minute, attacks against you cannot have advantage and you treat any d20 of 9 or lower as a 10 on attacks, checks and saves; once per long rest or for 5 sorcery points.
Clockwork Cavalcade
A 30-foot cube heals 100 hit points among creatures in it, ends spells of 6th level or lower, and repairs damaged objects; once per long rest or for 7 sorcery points.
Lunar Embodiment
A rotating set of moon spells always known, and healing or damaging sorcerer spells you cast can shift to radiant or cold.
Moon Fire
A bonus action changes your lunar phase: Full grants a radiant aura, New grants concealment, Crescent grants extra reach and movement.
Lunar Boons
Your current phase empowers a matching school of spells, and a sorcery point can shift the phase mid-fight.
Waxing and Waning
Spend sorcery points to shift phase as a free action and add your Charisma modifier to a lunar spell's damage or healing once per turn.
Lunar Phenomenon
Once per long rest or for 5 sorcery points, unleash the full power of your phase in a 30-foot burst that heals allies, blinds enemies or hastens you depending on the moon.
Fey Presence
An action charms or frightens every creature in a 10-foot cube that fails a Wisdom save until the end of your next turn; recharges on a short or long rest.
Misty Escape
A reaction on taking damage turns you invisible and teleports you 60 feet; recharges on a short or long rest.
Beguiling Defenses
Immunity to being charmed, and a reaction turns a charm attempt back on the caster for 1 minute and 3d10 psychic damage per turn.
Dark Delirium
Wrap a creature within 60 feet in illusion for a minute: charmed or frightened, unable to perceive anything else, and removable to the Feywild until the effect ends.
Awakened Mind
Speak telepathically to any creature within 30 feet that shares a language with you.
Entropic Ward
A reaction imposes disadvantage on an attack against you, and a miss grants advantage on your next attack against that creature; recharges on a short or long rest.
Thought Shield
Your thoughts cannot be read, you resist psychic damage, and psychic damage dealt to you is dealt back to the attacker.
Create Thrall
An incapacitated humanoid you touch becomes charmed until a remove curse, with telepathic contact at any distance on the same plane.
Bonus Cantrips (Celestial)
You know light and sacred flame.
Healing Light
A pool of d6s equal to 1 + your warlock level, spendable as a bonus action to heal a creature within 60 feet; refills on a long rest.
Radiant Soul
Resistance to radiant damage, and once per turn add your Charisma modifier to a radiant or fire spell's damage.
Celestial Resilience
Temporary hit points after every rest, for you and up to five allies, equal to your warlock level plus your Charisma modifier.
Searing Vengeance
When you would make a death save, rise instead at half hit points, blinding and burning enemies within 30 feet for 2d8 + Charisma radiant damage; recharges on a long rest.
Hexblade's Curse
A bonus action curses a creature for a minute: bonus damage equal to your proficiency bonus, critical hits on a 19 or 20, and hit points back when it dies; recharges on a short or long rest.
Hex Warrior
Proficiency with medium armor, shields and martial weapons, and one weapon each day uses Charisma for attack and damage.
Accursed Specter
A humanoid you kill rises as a specter under your command until your next long rest; recharges on a long rest.
Armor of Hexes
An attack from your cursed target misses on a coin-flip d6 roll even when it would hit.
Master of Hexes
When your cursed target dies, move the curse to a new creature without spending a rest.
Tentacle of the Deep
A bonus action summons a spectral tentacle for a minute that attacks for 1d8 cold damage and halves a target's speed; a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Gift of the Sea
A 40-foot swimming speed and the ability to breathe underwater.
Oceanic Soul
Immunity to cold damage, full immersion comfort, and the ability to speak with any creature underwater.
Guardian Coil
Your tentacle reduces damage to you or a creature near it by 1d8, rising to 2d8 at 10th level.
Grasping Tentacles
You always have evard's black tentacles prepared, gain temporary hit points when you cast it, and keep concentration through damage more easily.
Fathomless Plunge
Teleport yourself and up to five willing creatures to a body of water within a mile; recharges on a short or long rest.
Genie's Vessel

A vessel tied to your patron: once per long rest, Bottled Respite lets you retreat inside it for 10 minutes, and Genie's Wrath adds your proficiency bonus in your patron's damage type to one hit per turn.
Elemental Gift
Resistance to your patron's damage type, and a bonus action grants a 30-foot flying speed for 10 minutes, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Sanctuary Vessel
Bottled Respite takes up to five companions with you, and everyone who finishes a short rest inside gains temporary hit points.
Limited Wish
Once per 1d4 long rests, replicate any spell of 6th level or lower without components.
Form of Dread

A bonus action for a minute grants temporary hit points of 1d10 + warlock level, immunity to fear, and the power to frighten one creature you hit each turn; a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Grave Touched
You need no food, drink or air, and once per turn a damaging attack can deal necrotic damage instead, with a bonus die while in Form of Dread.
Necrotic Husk
Immunity to necrotic damage, and once per long rest dropping to 0 hit points instead leaves you at 1 and blasts nearby creatures for necrotic damage equal to your warlock level.
Spirit Projection

For an hour, project your spirit: resistance to most damage, the ability to move through solid matter, and necrotic and psychic spell damage that heals you; once per long rest or with a 5th-level slot.
Among the Dead
You know spare the dying, undead have disadvantage attacking you unless you attack them, and you have advantage on saves against disease.
Defy Death
Regain 1d8 + your Constitution modifier hit points when you succeed on a death save or stabilize a creature; recharges on a long rest.
Undying Nature
You barely need to breathe, eat or sleep, you no longer age, and you cannot be aged magically.
Indestructible Life
A bonus action heals 1d8 + your warlock level and reattaches severed body parts; recharges on a short or long rest.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.wizard.s: Abjuration Savant
Copying abjuration spells into your book costs half the time and gold.
Arcane Ward

Casting an abjuration spell of 1st level or higher raises a ward with hit points equal to twice your wizard level plus your Intelligence modifier, which absorbs damage aimed at you and recharges as you cast.
Projected Ward
A reaction makes your Arcane Ward absorb damage aimed at a creature within 30 feet.
Improved Abjuration
Add your proficiency bonus to ability checks made as part of an abjuration spell, such as counterspell and dispel magic.
Spell Resistance
Advantage on saves against spells, and resistance to damage from spells.
Conjuration Savant
Copying conjuration spells into your book costs half the time and gold.
Minor Conjuration
An action conjures a nonmagical object up to 3 feet on a side and 10 pounds for an hour.
Benign Transposition
Teleport 30 feet or swap places with a willing creature; recharges on a long rest or when you cast a conjuration spell.
Focused Conjuration
Concentration on a conjuration spell cannot be broken by taking damage.
Durable Summons
Creatures you summon get 30 temporary hit points.
Divination Savant
Copying divination spells into your book costs half the time and gold.
Portent
Roll two d20s after each long rest and replace any attack, check or save made by you or a creature you can see with one of them; three dice from 14th level.
Expert Divination
Casting a divination spell of 2nd level or higher returns one expended slot of lower level.
The Third Eye
After a rest, gain darkvision, ethereal sight, greater comprehension or see invisibility until your next rest.
Greater Portent
You roll three Portent dice after each long rest instead of two.
Enchantment Savant
Copying enchantment spells into your book costs half the time and gold.
Hypnotic Gaze
An action charms and incapacitates a creature within 5 feet until the end of your next turn, extendable each turn; recharges on a short or long rest.
Instinctive Charm
A reaction redirects an attack aimed at you onto another creature within the attacker's reach on a failed Wisdom save; recharges on a short or long rest.
Split Enchantment
An enchantment spell of 1st level or higher that targets one creature can target a second.
Alter Memories
A charmed creature forgets it was charmed, and you can strip up to your Charisma modifier plus one hour of memory on a failed save.
Illusion Savant
Copying illusion spells into your book costs half the time and gold.
Improved Minor Illusion
You know minor illusion and can create sound and an image with the same casting.
Malleable Illusion
An action reshapes an illusion you are concentrating on while it lasts.
Illusory Self
A reaction interposes an illusory duplicate so an attack that would hit you misses; recharges on a short or long rest.
Illusory Reality
A bonus action makes one object in your illusion real for a minute.
Necromancy Savant
Copying necromancy spells into your book costs half the time and gold.
Grim Harvest
Once per turn, killing a creature with a spell of 1st level or higher restores twice the spell's level in hit points, three times for necromancy spells.
Undead Thralls
You learn animate dead, raise one extra corpse per casting, and your undead gain extra hit points and add your proficiency bonus to weapon damage.
Inured to Undeath
Resistance to necrotic damage, and your hit point maximum cannot be reduced.
Command Undead
An action takes control of an undead creature on a failed Charisma save, with intelligent undead getting a fresh save each time they take damage.
Transmutation Savant
Copying transmutation spells into your book costs half the time and gold.
Minor Alchemy
Ten minutes of concentration converts one material into another, such as wood into stone, for an hour.
Transmuter's Stone

Master Transmuter

Add your Intelligence modifier to initiative.
Store surges from dispelled or countered spells, up to your Intelligence modifier, and spend one to add half your wizard level to a damaging spell's damage.

callingMaterial.subclassFeature.wizard.b: Proficiency with light armor, one one-handed melee weapon, and the Performance skill.
A bonus action for a minute grants +Intelligence to AC, 10 feet of speed, advantage on Acrobatics and a concentration-save bonus; a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Attack twice with the Attack action, and one of those attacks may be a cantrip with a casting time of one action.
A reaction while bladesinging spends a spell slot to reduce damage to you by five times the slot level.
Add your Intelligence modifier to melee weapon damage while bladesinging.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.wizard.c: A reaction forces a creature within 30 feet to reroll an attack, check or save, twice per long rest.
Add your Intelligence modifier to initiative.
A Large or smaller creature within 60 feet is frozen in time until the end of your next turn on a failed Constitution save; a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Store a spell of 4th level or lower in a bead that anyone can break to cast it; recharges on a short or long rest.
A reaction dictates the outcome of a roll within 60 feet as a success or a failure, at the cost of a level of exhaustion.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.wizard.g: Halve or double a creature's or object's weight for a minute, changing its speed, carrying capacity and Strength checks.

A 30-foot field of crushing gravity for a minute that deals 2d10 force damage and halts movement on a failed Strength save; once per long rest or with a 4th-level slot.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.wizard.o: Conjure a magic quill that needs no ink, scribes at speed, and can erase what it wrote.

callingMaterial.subclassFeature.cleric.k: Two extra languages and proficiency plus expertise in two knowledge skills.

Gain proficiency with one skill or tool of your choice for 10 minutes.
Read a creature's surface thoughts for a minute and cast suggestion on it without a slot.
Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.
A minute of concentration reveals an object's or a place's recent history.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.cleric.l: A reaction imposes disadvantage on an attack against you, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
Dispel magical darkness within 30 feet and deal 2d10 + cleric level radiant damage to hostile creatures, halved on a Constitution save.

Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.
For a minute, shed 60 feet of bright light and give enemies in it disadvantage on saves against fire and radiant spells.

A bonus action commands creatures charmed by your Channel Divinity.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.cleric.t: Proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

Deal maximum damage instead of rolling for lightning or thunder damage.

Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 thunder damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed while not underground or indoors.
Touch a willing creature to give it advantage on Stealth checks for an hour.
Create an illusory double for a minute that you can move, cast spells through, and use to gain attack advantage.
Become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack or cast.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 poison damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
Invoke Duplicity creates up to four illusory duplicates.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.cleric.w: Proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.
A bonus-action weapon attack when you take the Attack action, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
Add +10 to one attack roll, before or after seeing the result.
A reaction grants an ally within 30 feet +10 on an attack roll.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's type, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.cleric.d: Learn a necromancy cantrip; single-target necromancy cantrips can hit a second creature within 5 feet of the first.
A melee hit deals extra necrotic damage equal to 5 + twice your cleric level.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 necrotic damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
Cast a necromancy spell of 1st to 5th level that targets one creature at two creatures within 5 feet, at the cost of 1d8 of your own hit points per spell level.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.cleric.f: Proficiency with heavy armor and smith's tools.
After a long rest, enchant a weapon or suit of armor you touch with a +1 bonus until you use the feature again.
An hour of ritual smithing creates a simple metal item worth up to 100 gp.
+1 AC while wearing heavy armor, and resistance to fire damage.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 fire damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
Immunity to fire damage, and resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing while in heavy armor.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.cleric.g: Healing spells cast on a creature at 0 hit points heal the maximum; you can cast spare the dying at 30 feet as a bonus action.
Detect undead within 60 feet as an action, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
Curse a creature so the next attack against it has advantage and doubles its damage vulnerability for that hit.
A reaction turns a critical hit against a creature within 30 feet into a normal hit, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.
Once per turn, when an enemy within 60 feet dies, an ally you can see regains hit points equal to its Hit Dice.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.cleric.o: Heavy armor, plus proficiency in Intimidation or Persuasion.
After a spell of 1st level or higher targets an ally, that ally may use a reaction to make one weapon attack.
Creatures of your choice within 30 feet are charmed for a minute on a failed Wisdom save, and you may drop or push one of them 30 feet.
A Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest, cast an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher as a bonus action.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 psychic damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
Once per turn, a creature you damage with Divine Strike takes an extra 2d8 psychic damage the next time an ally hits it.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.cleric.p: Proficiency in Performance, Insight or Persuasion.
Bond a proficiency-bonus number of creatures for 10 minutes; while near each other they may add a d4 to an attack, check or save, once per turn.
Move without provoking and heal each creature you pass within 5 feet for 2d6 + your Wisdom modifier.

Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.
Emboldening Bond's range grows to 60 feet and Protective Bond halves the damage taken.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.cleric.t: Darkvision out to 300 feet, shareable with a Wisdom-modifier number of creatures once per long rest.
Touch a creature to give it advantage on its next initiative roll.
A 30-foot aura for a minute that grants each ally either temporary hit points of 1d6 + cleric level or an end to a charm or fear effect, each round.
A bonus action in dim light or darkness grants flight for a minute, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
Allies inside Twilight Sanctuary have half cover.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.cleric.a: Proficiency in Arcana and two wizard cantrips of your choice.
Turn one celestial, elemental, fey or fiend within 30 feet on a failed Wisdom save, banishing weaker ones outright at higher levels.
Restoring hit points with a spell also ends one spell of equal or lower level on the target.
Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.
Add four wizard spells of 6th, 7th, 8th and 9th level to your cleric spell list.

Wild Shape into beasts of challenge rating 1 at 2nd level, and up to a third of your druid level rounded down from 6th level on.

Spend two Wild Shape uses at once to become an air, earth, fire or water elemental.

A bonus action teleports you 60 feet, or a creature you touch 30 feet, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
After a short rest, cast dream, scrying or teleportation circle without a slot, the circle keyed to a place you have seen.
You learn Sylvan and can speak with beasts.

Creatures you conjure gain 2 extra hit points per Hit Die and their attacks count as magical.

Hurl your spores into a 10-foot cube within 30 feet, damaging creatures that start their turn there instead of using Halo of Spores.
Immunity to blindness, deafness, fear and poison, and critical hits against you count as normal hits.
A charted map serving as your spellcasting focus; you know guidance and can cast guiding bolt a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest without a slot.

You and allies within 10 feet have resistance to damage from spells, growing to 30 feet at 18th level.

Once per long rest, drop to 1 hit point instead of 0, and you no longer age or weaken with time.

For a minute: regain 10 hit points each turn, cast paladin spells as a bonus action, and enemies within 10 feet have disadvantage on saves against your spells and Channel Divinity.

One creature within 60 feet is frightened and its speed drops to 0 for a minute on a failed Wisdom save, half that on a success.

A bonus action grants advantage on attacks against one creature within 10 feet for a minute.

An opportunity-attack hit lets you move up to half your speed as part of the reaction, without provoking.

A reaction makes a melee attack against a creature under your Vow of Enmity when it attacks.

For an hour, gain a 60-foot flying speed and a 30-foot aura that frightens enemies who fail a Wisdom save, giving you advantage against them.

Every creature within 30 feet that fails a Wisdom save is frightened for a minute, saving again each turn.

Add +10 to one attack roll after seeing the result.

A +5 bonus to Persuasion checks for 10 minutes.
Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent
A reaction deals the same damage back to an attacker who wounded someone near you, halved on a Wisdom save.

A reaction takes the damage aimed at an ally within 10 feet onto yourself, ignoring resistance; 30 feet at 18th level.

Regain 1d6 + half your paladin level hit points at the end of your turn in combat when below half your maximum.

Resistance to all damage from other creatures, and attackers take radiant damage equal to half of what they dealt you, until you attack or harm someone.
Channel Divinity: Peerless Athlete
For 10 minutes, advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics, extra carrying capacity, and 10 extra feet of jump distance.
Channel Divinity: Inspiring Smite
After a Divine Smite, hand out temporary hit points of 2d8 + paladin level split among creatures within 30 feet.
Aura of Alacrity
Your speed rises by 10 feet, and allies within 5 feet gain 10 feet of speed until their next turn; 10 feet of aura at 18th level.

For a minute: advantage on Charisma checks, a missed attack can be rerolled once per turn, and failed saves can be turned into successes once per turn.

Aura of the Sentinel

Creatures of your choice within 30 feet that fail a Wisdom save cannot move more than 30 feet away from you.

Creatures of your choice within 30 feet below half hit points regain 1d6 + your Charisma modifier hit points.
Divine Allegiance
A reaction takes the damage aimed at a creature within 5 feet onto yourself, ignoring resistance.
Unyielding Spirit
Advantage on saving throws against being paralyzed or stunned.
Exalted Champion
For an hour: resistance to nonmagical weapon damage, advantage on Wisdom saves for you and allies within 30 feet, and death saves at advantage for the same.
Channel Divinity: Control Undead
One undead of CR at or below your level within 30 feet obeys you for 24 hours on a failed Charisma save.
Channel Divinity: Dreadful Aspect
Creatures of your choice within 30 feet that fail a Wisdom save are frightened for a minute.
Aura of Hate
You, fiends and undead within 10 feet add your Charisma modifier to melee weapon damage; 30 feet at 18th level.
Supernatural Resistance
Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
Dread Lord

For a minute: a 30-foot aura of magical darkness that deals 4d10 psychic damage to enemies who start their turn in it, gives attackers disadvantage against you, and lets you make a spectral 4d10 psychic attack as a bonus action.

Proficiency with medium armor, shields and martial weapons.

A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die may add it to a damage roll, or use a reaction to add it to AC against one attack.
Extra Attack
Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
Battle Magic
After casting a spell with an action, a bonus action makes one weapon attack.

A bonus action spends a Bardic Inspiration to give allies within 60 feet temporary hit points and an immediate reaction-free move.
Enthralling Performance
After a minute of performance, charm up to a proficiency-bonus number of humanoids that fail a Wisdom save; once per short or long rest.

Cast command as a bonus action for a minute without a slot, with listeners charmed against retaliating; once per long rest.
Unbreakable Majesty
A bonus action makes you awesome to behold for a minute: an attacker must pass a Charisma save or lose the attack and be unable to target you that turn.

Proficiency with medium armor and the scimitar; your weapon can serve as a spellcasting focus.
Fighting Style (Blade)
Choose the Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting style.
Blade Flourish
Your speed rises by 10 feet on any turn you take the Attack action, and once per turn you may spend a Bardic Inspiration die on a Defensive, Slashing or Mobile flourish.
Extra Attack
Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
Master's Flourish
Roll a d6 for a flourish instead of spending a Bardic Inspiration die.
Psychic Blades
Spend a Bardic Inspiration die on a weapon hit for extra psychic damage, 2d6 at 3rd level and rising with bard level.
Words of Terror
A minute of private conversation frightens a humanoid of you or someone you name for an hour on a failed Wisdom save; once per short or long rest.
Mantle of Whispers
A reaction captures the shadow of a humanoid that just died, letting you wear their identity for an hour; once per short or long rest.
Shadow Lore
Whisper a creature's darkest secret: on a failed Wisdom save it is charmed and obeys your requests for 8 hours; once per long rest.
Silver Tongue
Treat any d20 of 9 or lower as a 10 on Persuasion and Deception checks.
Unsettling Words
A bonus action spends a Bardic Inspiration die to subtract it from one creature's next saving throw.
Unfailing Inspiration
An inspiration die that fails to change the outcome is not spent.
Infectious Inspiration

You know guidance and can cast it at 60 feet.

An hour-long seance with allies lets you learn one divination or necromancy spell of a level up to the ritual's length and cast it until your next long rest.
Mystical Connection

Proficiency in Insight and Medicine and with a herbalism kit, plus a mask you are known by.

Once per turn, spend 1 ki on an unarmed hit for extra necrotic damage of your martial arts die plus your Wisdom modifier.

Once per long rest, spend 5 ki to return a creature dead no more than 24 hours to life with 4d10 + Wisdom hit points.

Spend 1 ki for a spirit visage granting darkvision, advantage on Insight and Intimidation, and an Astral Sight that pierces darkness.

Spend 5 ki for the complete astral body: +2 AC and an extra Arms attack when taking the Attack action.
You know Draconic, can shift your unarmed damage to acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison, and can add a d4 to a Charisma check once per short rest.
Replace one Attack-action attack with a 20-foot cone or 30-foot line dealing your martial arts die in damage, twice per long rest or by spending 1 ki.
While airborne from a jump or effect, gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
A bonus action creates a 10-foot aura for a minute that either frightens enemies or grants allies resistance to your damage type; once per long rest or for 3 ki.
Aspect of the Wyrm reaches 30 feet, grants blindsight, and once per turn lets you deal 3d10 damage to up to three creatures in it as a reaction.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.ranger.b: A beast of CR 1/4 or lower obeys your commands, adds your proficiency bonus to its rolls and AC, uses your hit points formula and takes the Dodge action unless you command otherwise.
A bonus action lets the companion Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help, and its attacks count as magical.
Your companion makes two attacks when you command it to attack.
A spell you cast on yourself also affects your companion within 30 feet.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.ranger.g: + your Wisdom modifier to initiative, and on your first turn 10 extra feet of speed plus one extra attack dealing an extra 1d8.
Darkvision 60 feet, or 30 more if you had it, and you are invisible to creatures relying on darkvision to see you in darkness.
Proficiency in Wisdom saves, or Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it.
Once per turn, a missed attack lets you make another one.
A reaction imposes disadvantage on an attack against you that would otherwise hit.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.ranger.h: Sense a planar portal within a mile once per short or long rest.

Teleport 10 feet before each attack, and attack a third creature if you struck two others this turn.
A reaction halves the damage of an attack that hits you.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.ranger.m: An action reveals a creature's damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
A bonus action marks a creature so your first hit against it each turn deals an extra 1d6.
Add 1d6 to saves and escape checks against effects from your Slayer's Prey target.
A reaction forces a caster or teleporter within 60 feet to make a Wisdom save or lose the spell; once per short or long rest.
A reaction attacks your prey when it forces a save on you, and a hit means the save automatically succeeds.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.ranger.f: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d4 psychic damage, rising to 1d6 at 11th level.
Add your Wisdom modifier to Charisma checks, and gain proficiency in one Charisma skill.
Charm person and other fey spells are always prepared and do not count against your spells known.
Advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened, and a reaction redirects a nearby charm or fear onto another creature.
Summon fey is always prepared and can be cast once per long rest without a slot, with the summon able to turn invisible.
Cast misty step without a slot a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest, bringing a willing creature within 5 feet along.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.ranger.s: Once per turn, a hit lets your swarm deal 1d6 piercing damage, move the target 15 feet, or move you 5 feet without provoking; 1d8 from 11th level.
Mage hand and a short list of swarm spells are always prepared and do not count against your spells known.
A bonus action grants a 10-foot flying speed for a minute, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Gathered Swarm knocks moved targets prone, gives you half cover when it moves you, and adds 1d6 to its damage.
A reaction gives resistance to damage taken and teleports you 30 feet, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.ranger.d: You know thaumaturgy and can speak Draconic.
Summon a Small drake once per long rest or with a spell slot; it acts on your turn, adds your proficiency bonus to its rolls, and has an elemental breath.
While the drake is out, you gain resistance to its damage type, the drake gains a fly speed, and your attacks count as magical with extra elemental damage.
Once per long rest, the drake exhales a 30-foot cone dealing 8d6 of its element, halved on a Dexterity save.
The drake becomes Large and rideable, gains extra hit points, and adds your proficiency bonus in damage to its attacks.
callingMaterial.subclassFeature.artifice: After a long rest you brew an elixir with a random effect: healing, swiftness, resilience, boldness, flight or transformation. You can brew more by spending spell slots, and the number rises with level.
Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage or healing roll of any spell you cast through your alchemical tools.
You can cast lesser restoration without a slot a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest, and your elixirs also grant temporary hit points.
You gain resistance to acid and poison damage, immunity to the poisoned condition, and can cast greater restoration and heal once per long rest each without a slot.
Your armor becomes a magical suit that needs no Strength, cannot be removed against your will, and replaces missing limbs.

Choose Guardian, whose thunder gauntlets punish enemies who ignore you and whose Defensive Field grants temporary hit points, or Infiltrator, whose lightning launcher fires at range and whose powered steps add speed and stealth.
Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.
Your armor counts as four separate items for infusions: its armor, its weapon, and its helmet and boots.
Guardian armor pulls in enemies within 30 feet and knocks them prone; Infiltrator armor makes a struck target glow, granting attackers advantage and dealing extra force damage.

A bonus action creates a Tiny or Small cannon that acts on your command: a flamethrower cone, a force ballista that pushes, or a protector that hands out temporary hit points. Once per long rest, or by spending a spell slot.
A wand, staff or rod becomes your firearm, adding 1d8 to one damage roll of each artificer spell you cast through it.
Your cannon deals an extra 1d8, and you can detonate it as an action for 3d8 force damage in a 20-foot radius, halved on a successful Dexterity save.
You can have two cannons at once, and you and your allies have half cover within 10 feet of one.
Proficiency with martial weapons, and you use Intelligence instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage with magic weapons.
A construct companion that acts on your turn, attacks with a force-empowered bite, and can use its reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack against a nearby ally.
Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.
Once per turn, a hit from your magic weapon or your defender deals an extra 2d6 force damage, or heals a creature within 30 feet for 2d6.
Arcane Jolt rises to 4d6, your defender gains +2 AC, and its deflecting reaction also deals force damage to the attacker.

entryCharacter.pregen.brakk.blurb: Hits first and asks later. Swing the greataxe, shrug off blows, and keep the others alive by standing in front of them.
entryCharacter.pregen.brakk.backstory: Raised in the high passes, Brakk came down to the lowlands when the herds died, and has not found a reason to go back.
entryCharacter.pregen.kara.blurb: Shield, sword and chain mail. The steadiest hand at the table: hard to hit, harder to move, and always has a plan for the door.
entryCharacter.pregen.kara.backstory: Ten years in a river baron's guard, mustered out when the baron ran out of money. Still salutes by habit.
entryCharacter.pregen.vex.blurb: Locks, shadows and a rapier. Scout ahead, find the trap before it finds you, and strike where it hurts.
entryCharacter.pregen.vex.backstory: Left a city guild one step ahead of a debt. Keeps a list of people who are owed, and a shorter list of people who are owed by Vex.
entryCharacter.pregen.sera.blurb: Mace, shield and a healer's hands. Keeps the party standing with Cure Wounds and Bless, and can hold a line herself.
entryCharacter.pregen.sera.backstory: A chapel orphan who learned that a steady voice and a steadier hand do more good than a sermon.

dmField.copy.c0002: One per line, name or SRD slug, optional xN for a count. Stat blocks come from the content pack.
dmField.copy.c0005: The server rolls the hiders' Stealth against each opponent's passive Perception; only those who notice nothing are surprised.
dmField.copy.c0009: Overrides the ambush roll for a whole side.
dmField.copy.c0015: How far the nearest enemy stands from the party. Empty, the sides open across the field.
dmField.copy.c0017: The lair acts on initiative 20 each round (Lair action).
dmField.copy.c0024: From their equipment. Blank uses the best weapon they carry.
dmField.copy.c0026: An attack-roll spell instead of a weapon, such as Fire Bolt. It takes the whole action.
dmField.copy.c0029: Only for a spell the content pack does not know.
dmField.copy.c0047: An attack spell of 1st level or higher: the slot cast from. Empty uses the spell's own level.
dmField.copy.c0049: Only for what the server cannot see. Conditions, cover, light, flanking and features are applied already.
dmField.copy.c0054: the ogre is tangled in the curtain
dmField.copy.c0055: Kept with the roll as your ruling, so the table can see why.
dmField.copy.c0057: A versatile weapon rolls its bigger die. Not with a shield on the arm.
dmField.copy.c0059: The bonus action of two-weapon fighting, after an attack with a light weapon.
dmField.copy.c0061: Paladin only. The slot is spent if the attack hits.
dmField.copy.c0063: Battle Master only. The Superiority Die is spent on a hit (on the roll for Precision Attack).
dmField.copy.c0065: Martial Arts' unarmed strike after the Attack action, or a raging Berserker's frenzy. Spends the bonus action.
dmField.copy.c0070: Monk 5+. One ki on a melee hit; the target saves CON or is stunned.
dmField.copy.c0072: Great Weapon Master (heavy melee) or Sharpshooter (ranged): -5 to hit for +10 damage. Powerful Attacker: disadvantage for +10. Deadeye: the proficiency bonus off the roll for twice it on the damage.
dmField.copy.c0074: Lucky: an extra d20 on this attack roll, the best kept; the point is spent.
dmField.copy.c0076: A ranged weapon critical hit stuns the target until the shooter's next turn instead of doubling the damage.
dmField.copy.c0078: Charger's bonus-action attack after a Dash: +5 damage when they ran at least 10 feet straight at the target.
dmField.copy.c0080: Barbarian 2+, first attack of the turn. Attacks against them have advantage until their next turn.
dmField.copy.c0082: Melee only. A creature dropped to 0 falls unconscious instead of dying.
dmField.copy.c0084: Hunter ranger, once a turn: an extra attack on a different creature within 5 feet of one already attacked.
dmField.copy.c0086: Advantage on this attack roll. Refused when they hold none.
dmField.copy.c0088: Rogue 20: a miss becomes a hit and spends the use (once a short rest); a hit spends nothing.
dmField.copy.c0090: Way of the Open Hand, on a Flurry of Blows strike only. The server rolls the target's save against the ki DC.
dmField.copy.c0093: No reactions until the monk's next turn ends
dmField.copy.c0095: Fiend warlock 14, on a hit: gone until the end of the warlock's next turn, then 10d10 psychic unless a fiend. Once a long rest.
dmField.copy.c0097: Samurai 15, once a turn: an attack with advantage gives it up for one more attack of the Attack action.
dmField.copy.c0099: Hunter 11: the action makes one melee attack against each creature within 5 feet; send one call per creature.
dmField.copy.c0101: Hunter 11: the action makes one ranged attack against each creature within 10 feet of the first; send one call per creature.
dmField.copy.c0103: Blank picks from the stat block.
dmField.copy.c0110: The server rolls 1d6 per 10 feet and lays it prone.
dmField.copy.c0112: From a spell or a magic weapon
dmField.copy.c0113: Resistance to nonmagical attacks does not apply to it.
dmField.copy.c0115: The AI DM must name one; the console's own hand may leave it empty.
dmField.copy.c0116: A hazard (a trap, a falling object)
dmField.copy.c0121: A known spell brings its own save; set it for one the server does not know.
dmField.copy.c0129: Leave empty for a cantrip or the spell's own level.
